name: kern-monorepo
description: KERN — backend structure and portable route logic for TypeScript/Express and Python/FastAPI parity.
author: cukas

scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter '!kern-monorepo' --filter '!@kernlang/review-python' test && pnpm test:infra && pnpm check:rule-coverage
scripts.test:non-semantics: pnpm -r --filter '!kern-monorepo' --filter '!@kernlang/review-python' test --testPathIgnorePatterns=ir-semantics && pnpm test:infra && pnpm check:rule-coverage
scripts.test:kern: pnpm --filter @kernlang/test build && node packages/test/dist/cli.js examples/native-test --coverage --min-coverage 100 && node packages/test/dist/cli.js packages/core/native-test --coverage --min-coverage 100
scripts.test:runner-smoke: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && pnpm --filter @kernlang/cli build && node ./scripts/check-kern-run-smoke.mjs && node ./scripts/check-kern-5-preview-app.mjs && node --test ./scripts/runner-browser-budget-policy.test.mjs ./scripts/selfhost-smoke-policy.test.mjs && node ./scripts/check-runner-browser-budget.mjs && pnpm test:capstone-flatten && pnpm test:capstone-assertion-engine && pnpm test:capstone-checker-subset && pnpm test:selfhost-validator
scripts.test:capstone-checker-subset: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && pnpm --filter @kernlang/cli build && node --test ./scripts/capstone-checker-subset/flatten-kern.test.mjs && node ./scripts/check-capstone-checker-subset.mjs
scripts.test:kern-ir-profile: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && node --import tsx --test packages/core/tests/kir-v1.test.ts && node --test scripts/kir-v1/acceptance-manifest.test.mjs && node ./scripts/check-kir-v1-profile.mjs
scripts.test:kern-ir: pnpm test:kern-ir-profile && pnpm test:kern-ir-eligibility && pnpm test:kern-canonical-value && pnpm test:kern-kir-structural-constitution && pnpm test:kern-kir-structural-codec && pnpm test:kern-kir-module-graph && pnpm test:kern-kir-runtime-binding && pnpm test:kern-kir-runner-composed-evidence && pnpm test:kern-kir-coverage-closure && pnpm test:kern-kir-evidence && pnpm test:kern-alpha-receipt && pnpm test:kern-runtime-contract-v1 && node ./scripts/check-kir-v1-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:kern-runtime-contract-v1: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && pnpm --filter @kernlang/core test --testPathPatterns=runtime-contract-v1-parity && node --test scripts/runtime-contract-v1/*.test.mjs packages/core/tests/runtime-contract-v1-candidate.test.mjs packages/core/tests/runtime-contract-v1-effects.test.mjs && node ./scripts/check-runtime-contract-v1.mjs
scripts.test:kern-canonicalizer: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && pnpm --filter @kernlang/cli build && node scripts/kern-canonicalizer/composition.mjs && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js check examples/kern-canonicalizer/canonicalizer.composed.kern --with-semantics --quiet && node --test scripts/kern-canonicalizer/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-kern-canonicalizer.mjs && node scripts/check-kern-canonicalizer-cli.mjs && node scripts/check-kern-canonicalizer-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:kern-frontend-stitch-shadow: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && node --test scripts/kern-frontend-stitcher/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-kern-frontend-stitcher.mjs
scripts.test:kern-frontend-lexical-shadow: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && node --test scripts/kern-frontend-lexical/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-kern-frontend-lexical.mjs
scripts.test:kern-frontend-builtin-node-type-att: pnpm --filter @kernlang/core build && pnpm check:kern-frontend-builtin-node-catalog && node --test scripts/kern-frontend-builtin-node-type-attestation/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-kern-frontend-builtin-node-type-attestation-regressions.mjs
scripts.test:infra: pnpm test:prepush && pnpm test:release-policy && pnpm test:kern-5-fitness && pnpm test:kern-semantic-ownership && pnpm test:kern-ir && pnpm test:kern-canonical-value && pnpm test:kern-kir-structural-constitution && pnpm test:kern-kir-structural-codec && pnpm test:kern-kir-module-graph && pnpm test:kern-kir-runtime-binding && pnpm test:kern-kir-runner-composed-evidence && pnpm test:kern-kir-coverage-closure && pnpm test:kern-kir-evidence && pnpm test:kern-alpha-receipt && pnpm test:kern-runtime-envelope && pnpm test:kern-runtime-contract-v1 && pnpm test:runtime-abi && pnpm test:core-runtime-internalization && pnpm test:source-runner-convergence && pnpm test:kern-canonicalizer && pnpm test:kern-frontend-tokenizer && pnpm test:kern-frontend-stitch-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-indentation-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-lexical-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-comment-boundary-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-whitespace-trim-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-retained-token-stream-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-node-type-token-admission-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-builtin-node-type-attestation-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-mutable-node-type-registry-snapshot-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-known-node-warning-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-generic-property-admission-shadow && pnpm test:kern-frontend-generic-property-loop-shadow
